description: Brand-specific campaign calendar relevance. Novelty holidays that clash with ritual reading identity are excluded.

strong_alignments.fall_reading_season: The Reading Hour ritual and literary identity
strong_alignments.holiday_gifting: Heirloom objects as considered gifts when inventory allows
strong_alignments.mothers_day: Thoughtful gifting when inventory and tone allow

weak_or_conditional.halloween: Only if tone stays quiet and literary; avoid costume novelty
weak_or_conditional.black_friday: Avoid discount theater; prefer waitlist or first-access framing when inventory is unavailable
weak_or_conditional.cyber_monday: Same as Black Friday — no false urgency or fake availability
